events_seen: CUT (Oct 17 (3 days ago)): Corbishley released Jacob Saylors (RB, DET).
FREE AGENT ADD (Oct 17 (3 days ago)): Corbishley added Tanner McKee (QB, PHI) (dropped Carson Wentz (QB, MIN)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 16 (4 days ago)): Kevin added Jahan Dotson (WR, ATL).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 14 (6 days ago)): Drew added Brandin Cooks (WR, SF) (dropped Joe Mixon (RB, FA)).

WEEK 6 RESULTS: Fronge def. Corbishley, 103.8-88.3; Charles def. Adam, 136.8-112.3; Brent def. Drew, 132.3-57.5 (BLOWOUT); Jake def. Shaq, 113.8-101.9; Kevin def. Wingard, 114.3-59.7 (BLOWOUT); Mitchum def. Ryan, 149.1-122.1

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Fronge beat Corbishley 103.8-88.3 from Havana and I had ForgeHammer. The regulatory flexibility is apparently also helping with the fantasy scoring. 7-5 on the season and I will be taking questions.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: The exchange board has Mitchum at $94.32 after a loss to Ryan, Charles at $146.42 after a loss to Adam, and Drew at $35.28 after — well, Drew. Three firms in very different kinds of trouble and the Week 7 schedule tests all three of them. The numbers this Friday are going to be uncomfortable for at least one of those desks.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Drew is 0-12 and faces Adam at 2-10 this week. One of these teams is going to get their first or third win. That sentence should tell you everything about where the bottom of this league has settled. ATLAS at $35.28 is not a buying opportunity, it is a warning label.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: The Jake vs Kevin matchup this week is the one I'd be most reluctant to pick. EchoPoint at 6-6 with that RB backfield against a Redline squad that just blew out Wingard — both firms are fighting for playoff positioning and neither has a cushion. The model hates games where variance is this high on both sides.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called the Kevin momentum story three weeks ago and the man just went 114.3-59.7 against Wingard to sit at 9-3. Redline Distressed Capital, inherited chaos, trust deficit, $93.69 on the exchange — and Kevin is the third-place firm in this league right now. That is a real business turnaround whether the market prices it or not.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: Season record is 6-7 and I am choosing to focus on trajectory. Also Fronge beating Corbishley was the second-most surprising result of the week and I had ForgeHammer, so the ledger has two correct calls on it from Tuesday forward. We are doing this differently now.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: MITCHUM DROPS A WINNABLE GAME TO RYAN AND THE EXCHANGE STILL HAD DEEP UP 7.6% TO $94.32 GOING INTO THE WEEK. THE BOARD PRICED IN A STORY. THE SCOREBOARD SAID NO. DEEPWATER HAS THE POINTS — 861.6 PF, FOURTH IN THE LEAGUE — AND SOMEHOW STILL FINDS WAYS TO HAND WINS TO THE DEFENDING CHAMPION.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Corbishley added Tanner McKee and dropped Carson Wentz in the same transaction and nobody is talking about it. The QB division at Apex was already one injury from crisis — this is not a stabilization move, this is a panic move dressed up in waiver wire clothing.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Corbishley vs Shaq this week. Apex needs a statement after Fronge handed them that loss — 9-3 is still a playoff position but the optics of losing to a 5-7 squad in Havana do not look great on the tape. I want this matchup on the main preview segment. Someone make it happen.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Week 7 is set and the schedule handed Charles a gift: Wingard at 3-9, $54.08 on the exchange, sitting on a blowout loss to Kevin last week. The bounce-back game was always going to be against someone like this. The Ledger will note whether CROWN prices in the relief or keeps sliding.
